name: The Loop
when: A drawing moves on its own frame by frame, starting only while the gate lets motion run and stopping as the gate stands motion still
replaces: The frame loop the coupling chart wrote by hand for its sweep, and the one the front page's canvas ran

examples.name: A Running Clock
examples.says: Playing counts the seconds the loop has run, and the page's pause or a preference for reduced motion stops the count where it stands.
